mapper.select: SELECT status, started_at, ended_at, records_processed, error_message FROM batch_log WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} ORDER BY log_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.country_code, b.status, b.started_at, b.ended_at, b.records_processed, b.error_message FROM batch_log b INNER JOIN ( SELECT country_code, MAX(log_id) AS max_id FROM batch_log WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} GROUP BY country_code ) latest ON b.log_id = latest.max_id ORDER BY b.country_code
SELECT * FROM exchange_rate WHERE rate_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY currency_code
SELECT * FROM batch_log ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT MAX(ended_at) AS last_sync, MAX(status) AS last_status FROM batch_log WHERE batch_name = 'LARGE_PRODUCT_SYNC' AND (country_code = #{countryCode} OR country_code = 'ALL')
SELECT country_code, country_name, currency, is_active FROM country_ent ORDER BY country_code
SELECT product_code, product_name_ko, status FROM product_master

SELECT f.country_code, e.country_name, IFNULL(SUM(f.amount_krw), 0) AS total_krw, IFNULL(SUM(f.quantity), 0) AS total_qty FROM country_ent e LEFT JOIN fact_sales f ON e.country_code = f.country_code GROUP BY f.country_code, e.country_name
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount_krw), 0) FROM fact_sales WHERE sale_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_log (batch_name, country_code, status, started_at, ended_at, records_processed, error_message) VALUES (#{batchName}, #{countryCode}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, NOW(), #{records}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select:
SELECT batch_name, COUNT(*) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status='FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_cnt, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, started_at, ended_at)), 1) AS avg_sec FROM batch_log WHERE started_at >= #{sinceDate}
GROUP BY batch_name ORDER BY batch_name
